== virtualUSB sessions

Connecting a device through virtualUSB now starts a virtualUSB session instead of retaining the device.

*Highlights*

- The device status shows *Utilizing* instead of *Retained* while connected through virtualUSB.
- virtualUSB sessions appear in the Session List, can be filtered by session type, and open to a session overview page.
- The same user can run a manual session or an Appium script alongside virtualUSB on the same device, in either order. The sessions combine into one mixed session.
- Disconnecting in virtualUSB, quitting the virtualUSB app, or terminating the session from the Portal ends the session and returns the device to *Online*.
- A virtualUSB session ends automatically after an idle period when the virtualUSB app stops sending keep-alive signals.

*Limitations*

- virtualUSB sessions do not include video, device logs, or Session Explorer details.
- Sessions that included virtualUSB cannot be converted to Test Cases.
- A CLI session started on a device connected through virtualUSB remains a separate session. Connecting virtualUSB to a device already in a CLI session is not supported.
